verdict.rationale: React docs stress interoperability ('add React to your existing page', 'use as little or as much React as you need') implying it can coexist with non-React DOM code, but the evidence pack never mentions refs/useRef or the escape-hatch APIs React actually uses for direct DOM manipulation to integrate libraries like D3 or charting tools. missing for 10: explicit useRef/ref forwarding documentation, guidance on wrapping imperative JS libraries, independent examples of charting library integration.
